articles.author: Kristin Wright
articles.title: Poison suspected in deaths of ten lions in game reserve in Tanzania - NPR
articles.description: The lions were found dead inside the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a popular wildlife reserve in Tanzania. Deaths raise concerns over wildlife poisonings in East Africa.
articles.content: Ten lions found dead in a wildlife reserve in Tanzania are suspected to have been poisoned, according to wildlife officials. The animals were discovered on Friday in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area,… [+1393 chars]
